# All Code Chunks

### Setting up Populations

Below are some parameters for setting up the populations.

```{r}
set.seed(123)
n_indv <- 45
n_loci <- 15
n_pop <- 3
n_rsloci <- 5
```

### Defining Populations

There will be five generated populations each with unique allele frequencies defined by me.

Note: The names for individuals in the populations are based alphabetically, rather than numerically (ex, Indv_A.1 vs Indv_1.1)

```{r}
#Population 1
p_1 <- 0.6
q_1 <- 1 - p_1
Pop_1 <- data.frame(matrix(sample(c("AA", "Aa", "aa"), size = n_indv * n_loci, replace = TRUE,prob = c(p_1^2, 2 * p_1 * q_1, q_1^2)),nrow = n_indv,ncol = n_loci))
rownames(Pop_1) <- paste0("Indv_A.", 1:n_indv)
colnames(Pop_1) <- paste0("Genotype_Locus", 1:n_loci)


#Population 2
p_2 <- 0.2
q_2 <- 1 - p_2

Pop_2 <- data.frame(matrix(sample(c("AA", "Aa", "aa"), size = n_indv * n_loci, replace = TRUE,prob = c(p_2^2, 2 * p_2 * q_2, q_2^2)),nrow = n_indv,ncol = n_loci))
rownames(Pop_2) <- paste0("Indv_B.", 1:n_indv)
colnames(Pop_2) <- paste0("Genotype_Locus", 1:n_loci)

#Population 3
p_3 <- 0.9
q_3 <- 1 - p_3
Pop_3 <- data.frame(matrix(sample(c("AA", "Aa", "aa"), size = n_indv * n_loci, replace = TRUE,prob = c(p_3^2, 2 * p_3 * q_3, q_3^2)),nrow = n_indv,ncol = n_loci))
rownames(Pop_3) <- paste0("Indv_C.", 1:n_indv)
colnames(Pop_3) <- paste0("Genotype_Locus", 1:n_loci)

#Population 4
p_4 <- 0.5
q_4 <- 1 - p_4
Pop_4 <- data.frame(matrix(sample(c("AA", "Aa", "aa"), size = n_indv * n_loci, replace = TRUE,prob = c(p_4^2, 2 * p_4 * q_4, q_4^2)),nrow = n_indv,ncol = n_loci))
rownames(Pop_4) <- paste0("Indv_D.", 1:n_indv)
colnames(Pop_4) <- paste0("Genotype_Locus", 1:n_loci)

#Population 5
p_5 <- 0.7
q_5 <- 1 - p_5
Pop_5 <- data.frame(matrix(sample(c("AA", "Aa", "aa"), size = n_indv * n_loci, replace = TRUE,prob = c(p_5^2, 2 * p_5 * q_5, q_5^2)),nrow = n_indv,ncol = n_loci))
rownames(Pop_5) <- paste0("Indv_E", 1:n_indv)
colnames(Pop_5) <- paste0("Genotype_Locus", 1:n_loci)

head(Pop_1)
head(Pop_2)
head(Pop_3)
head(Pop_4)
head(Pop_5)
```

### Randomized Sampling

Although I will be working with this generated data for future modules, I want to base each individual modules on randomly selected loci. I also selected 3 random populations to work with for this module.

```{r}

sample(Pop_1, 1)
sample(n_pop,3)

```

### Genotype Counts and Frequencies

Genotype counts are bound per population at the sampled locus. The same formula is used for defining and binding each population's genotype frequencies.

```{r}
#Binding genotype counts per population

gc_locus11 <- rbind(table(Pop_2$Genotype_Locus11), table(Pop_3$Genotype_Locus11), table(Pop_4$Genotype_Locus11))
rownames(gc_locus11) <- c("Pop_2", "Pop_3", "Pop_4")

#Checking table

gc_locus11
```

```{r}

#Defining frequencies for Locus 11

fq_locus11 <- gc_locus11 / sum(gc_locus11)
fq_locus11 <- round(fq_locus11, digits = 3)
rownames(fq_locus11) <- c("Pop_2", "Pop_3", "Pop_4")

fq_locus11


```

### Calculating Heterozygosity and Homozygosity

```{r}
#Homozygosity & Heterozygosity percentages

#Locus 11 
HMP2L11 <- sum(gc_locus11[1,1] + gc_locus11[1,3]) / sum(gc_locus11[2,]) * 100
HTP2L11 <- 100 - HMP2L11
HMP2L11
HTP2L11
Pop2_HTHM <- cbind(HTP2L11, HMP2L11)
Pop2_HTHM

HMP3L11 <- sum(gc_locus11[2,1] + gc_locus11[2,3]) / sum(gc_locus11[3,]) * 100
HTP3L11 <- 100 - HMP3L11
HMP3L11
HTP3L11

HMP4L11 <- sum(gc_locus11[3,1] + gc_locus11[3,3]) / sum(gc_locus11[3,]) * 100
HTP4L11 <- 100 - HMP4L11
HTP4L11
HMP4L11


P_HTL11 <- c(HTP2L11, HTP3L11, HTP4L11)
P_HTL11 <- round(P_HTL11, digits = 3)

P_HML11 <- c(HMP2L11, HMP3L11, HMP4L11)
P_HML11 <- round(P_HML11, digits = 3)

P_HTL11
P_HML11


RBHHL11 <- rbind(P_HML11, P_HTL11)
RBHHL11.1 <- cbind(P_HTL11, P_HML11)


colnames(RBHHL11) <- c("Pop_2", "Pop_3", "Pop_4")
rownames(RBHHL11) <- c("Homozygosity % ", "Heterozygosity %")
RBHHL11
RBHHL11.1
```

### Expected and Observed Heterozygosity Frequency

Below I calculated expected and observed heterozygosity between each population at locus one. Observed data based on the averages from generated population and expected data based on originally set allele frequency values.

```{r}
#Data for each sampled population at Locus 11
#Observed
#Ho = # of heterozygous individuals / total individuals

OHZP2L11 <- c(gc_locus11[1,2] / 45)
OHZP2L11 <- round(OHZP2L11, digits = 3)
OHZP2L11
 
#The formula below parses out the same answer :) ey
OHZP2L11 <- c(Op2_Aa =  2 * p_2 * q_2)
OHZP2L11 

OHZP3L11 <- c(Op3_Aa =  2 * p_3 * q_3)
OHZP3L11

OHZP4L11 <- c(Op4_Aa =  2 * p_4 * q_4)
OHZP4L11 

AOHZL11 <- cbind(OHZP2L11, OHZP3L11, OHZP4L11)
AOHZL11


#Expected HZ

EHZP2L11 <- c(Ep2_Aa =  2 * (fq_locus11[1,2] + fq_locus11[1,3]))
EHZP2L11 <- round(EHZP2L11, digits = 3)
EHZP2L11


EHZP3L11 <- c(Ep3_Aa =  2 * (fq_locus11[2,2] + fq_locus11[2,3]))
EHZP3L11 <- round(OHZP3L11, digits = 3)
EHZP3L11

EHZP4L11 <- c(Ep4_Aa =  2 * (fq_locus11[3,2] + fq_locus11[3,3]))
EHZP4L11 <- round(OHZP4L11, digits = 3)
EHZP4L11

AEHZL11 <- cbind(EHZP2L11, EHZP3L11, EHZP4L11)
AEHZL11

L11HZ <- rbind(AOHZL11, AEHZL11)
colnames(L11HZ) <- c("Pop 2", "Pop 3", "Pop 4")
rownames(L11HZ) <- c("Observed HZ", "Expected HZ")

L11HZ

```

# Figures

### Genotype Counts

```{r}
#Grouped Graphs for Genotype Counts
par(mfrow = c(1,2))

ylimgc <- c(0, 40)
gc_locus11R <- round(gc_locus11, digits = 2)

SPGCL11 <- barplot(gc_locus11, col=colors()[c(36, 12, 55)], border = "white", font.axis = 1, beside = T, xlab="Genotype Count", font.lab=1, ylim = ylimgc)
colnames(SPGCL11) <- c("aa", "Aa", "AA")
text(x = SPGCL11, y = gc_locus11, labels = gc_locus11R, adj = c(.5, -0.75), cex = .5, col = "black")

plot.new()
legend("center", legend = c("Pop2", "Pop3", "Pop4"), col = colors()[c(36, 12, 55)], lty = 1, bty = "n")
```

### Genotype Frequencies

```{r}
#Grouped Graphs for Genotype Frequencies
par(mfrow = c(1,2))

ylimfq <- c(0, 0.3)
fq_locus11R <- round(fq_locus11, digits = 2)

SPGFL11 <- barplot(fq_locus11, col=colors()[c(36, 12, 55)], border = "white", font.axis = 1, beside = T, xlab="Label", main = "Locus 11 Genotype Frequencies", font.lab=1, ylim = ylimfq)
colnames(SPGFL11) <- c("aa", "Aa", "AA")
text(x = SPGFL11, y = fq_locus11, labels = fq_locus11R, adj = c(.5, -0.75), cex = .5, col = "black")

plot.new()
legend("center", legend = c("Pop2", "Pop3", "Pop4"), col = colors()[c(36, 12, 55)], lty = 1, bty = "n")

```

### Heterozygosity vs. Homozygosity

```{r}
par(mfrow = c(1,2))

SPHHL11 <- barplot(RBHHL11, col=colors()[c(36,12)], border = "white", font.axis = 1, ylab = "Percent", xlab = "Populations", main = "Locus 11: Homo & Heterozygosity % ", font.lab = 1) 
text(x = SPHHL11, y = RBHHL11, labels = RBHHL11.1, adj = c(.5, -0.5), cex = .5, col = "black")


plot.new()
legend("center", legend = c("Homozygous", "Heterozygous"), col = colors()[c(36, 12)], lty = 1, bty = "n")
```

text(x = L11HZBP, y = L11HZ, labels = L11HZ, adj = c(.5, -0.5), cex = .75, col = "black")
